# Bosch BMP3 SensorAPI

Unmodified `bmp3.c`, `bmp3.h`, `bmp3_defs.h` and `LICENSE` from
[Bosch Sensortec BMP3_SensorAPI](https://github.com/boschsensortec/BMP3_SensorAPI/tree/db4cf8e4140c593b8c3d85f8c6c07335c7ffa9dc),
commit `db4cf8e4140c593b8c3d85f8c6c07335c7ffa9dc`, driver version 2.0.6.
These files retain their upstream line endings and BSD-3-Clause license.

The board adapter uses forced measurements and floating-point compensation
with the device's own calibration coefficients. Include [LICENSE](LICENSE)
when distributing firmware binaries that contain this driver.
